CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_configurations ( project_configuration_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, -- most likely won't be used but just add for now to be uniform project_id BIGINT, -- this REFERENCES (project.id) configuration_key VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, configuration_value TEXT,
/** either (project_key, configuration_key) or this should be the primary key but this will do for now **/ CONSTRAINT primary_identifier UNIQUE(project_id,configuration_key) );
